stop_condition:
Report HIGH only for a route by which an open design_conflict can be cleared or
authorized without a superseding satisfied DESIGN-REVIEW under which the
disputed unit's own content changed; or for a legitimate task the removal has
deadlocked. MEDIUM/LOW for everything else. If you find no HIGH, say so
plainly rather than manufacturing one.

findings.evidence: cmd_design_gate_precheck calls compute_design_conflict_open only inside the DESIGN_SATISFIED=true branch, then returns ready for no_design_attempted at line 8398 without reading conflicts. cmd_design_conflict accepts any validating docs/specs/<tid>.md artifact and does not require a DESIGN-ARTIFACT record. Therefore a task can be approved with --no-design while an unrecorded artifact already exists, receive a legitimate DESIGN-CONFLICT afterward, and still pass the Stop-time precheck because filing the conflict changes only Beads state.
findings.description: This authorizes an open design_conflict without any unit amendment or superseding satisfied DESIGN-REVIEW. Section 8h cannot catch the route because its subject has a recorded satisfied design, while Section 8i proves only the no-design case with no conflict.
